markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (96%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set and invasive probability under 1%, but the second model disagrees.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 96%, Normal 3%, InSitu 1% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / OOD 1.0 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Disagrees on top class | Independent check unsupportive |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 Benign, 4 Normal | Neighbors lean Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Scarce; favors non-invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 6, 11) · context · Above typical; descriptive only [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Low score; spot check 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Present; favors non-invasive · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions cuts invasive logit more than random (+0.54, CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown faithful. Mitoses unreliable, lymphocytes weak.

## Could be wrong if
- Second model disagrees and 4 of 5 neighbors are Normal; Benign versus Normal may be unsettled.
- Blur (severity 3) may hide nuclear detail; reliability ranking is modest (AUROC 0.69).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 8** — confirm stroma is non-infiltrating; its normal-lobule score is unreliable.
2. **Regions 1, 2, 10** — verify true gland formation rather than blur artifact.
3. **Regions 6, 11** — look for lymphocytic infiltrate and mitoses; both concepts are unreliable.
